name: Ricardo Villanueva
bio:
Ricardo’s journey into the high-octane world of motorsport began unconventionally – through his family's traditional Peruvian restaurant located near the Autódromo La Chutana. He catered small events for local racing teams, and his reputation for delicious, energizing meals quickly spread. Recognizing the crucial role of nutrition in performance, Ricardo developed a tailored approach to catering, focusing on providing drivers and crew with optimal fuel for race day. He joined Hot Car Competições five years ago, transforming their team's dietary strategy and contributing to improved stamina and focus during demanding races. His culinary expertise, combined with an understanding of motorsport's unique demands, makes him an invaluable asset to the team.

Ricardo's vision extends beyond just providing sustenance. He's constantly innovating, experimenting with new recipes and ingredients to enhance performance. He's also passionate about promoting Peruvian cuisine on a global stage, weaving traditional flavors into his motorsport catering to create a unique and memorable experience for everyone involved. He believes that a well-fed team is a winning team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Ricardo is a stout man with a warm smile and a perpetually energetic demeanor.

quirks: Insists on starting every day with a cup of strong mate de coca.
Always carries a small notebook filled with recipe ideas and nutritional analyses.
Has a habit of humming traditional Peruvian folk songs while preparing meals.
